InstantDelete.Name: Delete button deletes instantly
InstantDelete.Hint: Clicking the trash button on a chat message deletes it without a confirmation dialog.

PlayerEdit.Name: Players may edit/delete their own messages
PlayerEdit.Hint: Players can edit the content and speaker of messages they sent, and delete them. GMs can always edit every message.

ShowButtons.Name: Show edit/delete buttons on messages
ShowButtons.Hint: Adds edit (pencil) and delete (trash) buttons to the chat message header. When off, editing is available from the right-click menu only.

HideSecret.Name: Hide secret messages from players in archives
HideSecret.Hint: When players view an archive, whispers not addressed to them and blind rolls are hidden. GMs always see everything.

ShowPortrait.Name: Show portraits on chat cards
ShowPortrait.Hint: Shows the speaker's image on the first row of each message, next to the name (this client only). Uses the token image when the token is on a scene, otherwise the actor portrait; images are frozen when the message is posted, so later changes do not alter existing messages.

PortraitSize.Name: Portrait size (px)
PortraitSize.Hint: Side length of the chat card portrait.

ChatTheme.Name: Chat theme
ChatTheme.Hint: Background and text colour of chat message cards (this client only). Whispers and blind rolls get a light tint of their usual colour; chitchat and session markers keep their own colours.

ChatBgColor.Name: Chat background colour (custom)
ChatBgColor.Hint: Message background used when the chat theme is 'Custom'.

ChatTextColor.Name: Chat text colour (custom)
ChatTextColor.Hint: Message text colour used when the chat theme is 'Custom'.

ChatFontSize.Name: Chat base font size
ChatFontSize.Hint: Base font size of chat messages and the chat input (this client only). Chitchat uses 'Chitchat font size'.

ChitchatTrigger.Name: Extra chitchat trigger
ChitchatTrigger.Hint: Prefix used in addition to the built-in '/pt ', '`' and '!'. Leave empty to use only the built-in ones.

ChitchatAsOOC.Name: Create chitchat as OOC
ChitchatAsOOC.Hint: On: chitchat uses the OOC style. Off: the Other style.

ChitchatBrightness.Name: Chitchat background brightness
ChitchatBrightness.Hint: Chitchat is tinted with the sender's user colour; higher values are closer to white.

ChitchatLineBreak.Name: Line break after chitchat name
ChitchatLineBreak.Hint: Show the text on the line below the user name.

GroupMessages.Name: Group consecutive messages
GroupMessages.Hint: Consecutive messages by the same user and speaker are shown as one block (name and portrait omitted on continuations).

GroupChitchat.Name: Group consecutive chitchat
GroupChitchat.Hint: Consecutive chitchat messages are shown as one block.

GroupGap.Name: Maximum grouping gap (minutes)
GroupGap.Hint: Start a new block when a message is this far from the previous one. 0 = no limit.

SpeakerBar.Name: Show speaker bar
SpeakerBar.Hint: Shows above the chat input who the next message will be spoken as, with lock and favourites.

SpeakerFavorites.Name: Show speaker favourites
SpeakerFavorites.Hint: Shows a row of favourite speaker chips on the speaker bar.

SessionAnnounce.Name: Announce session start/end in chat
SessionAnnounce.Hint: Posts a marker card when a session starts or ends, which makes session boundaries easy to find in archives.

AutoThreshold.Name: Auto archive: chat message count
AutoThreshold.Hint: When the chat log holds more messages than this, the GM client saves everything since the last archive and clears archived messages from the log. 0 = off. Paused while a session runs (the session end saves it).

AutoKeep.Name: Recent messages to keep after auto archive
AutoKeep.Hint: When auto archive clears the log, this many of the newest messages stay (at most half the threshold).

AutoOnLoad.Name: Save leftovers when a GM logs in
AutoOnLoad.Hint: When a GM logs in and there are unarchived messages whose newest is over three hours old, they are saved as an archive of the previous sitting. (The moment a world shuts down cannot be caught reliably, so this happens at the next login.)

ChatImagesCompat.Name: Chat Images compatibility patch
ChatImagesCompat.Hint: When the Chat Images module is active: fixes the endless spinner on image paste in Foundry v13, turns off the hook debug logging it forces on, and pre-shrinks large screenshots so they upload quickly. Off = Chat Images' original behaviour.

ImageAttach.Name: Chat image attachments
ImageAttach.Hint: Paste, drop or pick images in the chat input; they are uploaded to the server and put in the message. Large screenshots are shrunk to WebP. Idle while the Chat Images module is active (its compatibility patch runs instead).

ImageUploadFolder.Name: Chat image upload folder
ImageUploadFolder.Hint: Folder under Data. The default matches Chat Images (uploaded-chat-images), so old and new images share it.

ImageUploadButton.Name: Show image button
ImageUploadButton.Hint: Show an image button in the chat controls (only with upload permission).

TokenHud.Name: Whisper menu when clicking a token
TokenHud.Hint: Clicking a token shows a translucent menu at the top of the screen for whispering straight to that token's owners. Appears for tokens with a player owner other than you and, for players, for any token that is not their assigned character. When several users share a token (covert play) they can whisper to each other through it (this client only).

Edit.Title: Edit Message
Edit.Speaker: Speaker (Actor)
Edit.AliasHint: Leave blank to use the actor (or user) name
Edit.ContentHint: Edits the raw HTML of the message body. For plain messages, just change the text. Ruby text is written as [[base|reading]].
Edit.NoPermission: You do not have permission to edit this message.
Edit.ChitchatNote: Chitchat is always shown under the sending player's name; the speaker cannot be changed.
Edit.TimestampHint: GM only. Changing it moves the message to that time position for everyone.

Archive.Name: Archive name
Archive.DeleteAfter: Delete from chat log after saving
Archive.DeleteAfterHint: Removes the saved messages from the chat log. The archive file is kept.
Archive.NoMessages: There are no messages to save.
Archive.DeleteConfirm: Remove archive "{name}" from the list? The file ({path}) stays on the server.
Archive.GMOnly: Only a GM can save archives.

Viewer.Title: Chat Archive
Viewer.ExportTooltip: Export the currently shown (filtered) messages as TXT / HTML / ZIP / folder, or open them in a new window
Viewer.NothingToExport: There are no messages to export.
Viewer.IncludeChitchatHint: Include chitchat messages in the list (also applies to export)

DeleteRange.Title: Delete Chat Messages
DeleteRange.Hint: Deletes the current chat messages in the chosen range. Messages that were never archived are lost too; this cannot be undone.
DeleteRange.Confirm: Delete {count} messages? This cannot be undone.
DeleteRange.NoMessages: There are no messages to delete.

SpeakerBar.NothingToLock: No speaker to lock. Select a token or assign a character.
SpeakerBar.FavDuplicate: That speaker is already a favourite.

ExportDialog.Title: Export Chat Log
ExportDialog.ModeTxtHint: Readable plain text, no images or formatting.
ExportDialog.ModeHtmlHint: CSS and images (portraits included) are embedded in one file that opens anywhere.
ExportDialog.ModeZipHint: HTML + chat-styles.css + images/ + portraits/ as a zip. Unpack several sessions into one folder to share CSS and images.
ExportDialog.ModeDirHint: Pick a folder once; later exports write HTML, CSS and images straight into it (Chrome, Edge and the Foundry app only).
ExportDialog.ModeWindowHint: Shows the log in a new browser window without creating a file.
ExportDialog.DirUnsupported: This browser does not support saving to a folder.
ExportDialog.DirReset: Export folder cleared; you will be asked again next time.
ExportDialog.PopupBlocked: Popup blocked. Allow popups and try again.
ExportDialog.ModeMdHint: A .md text that pastes well into Discord, Notion, Obsidian and the like.
ExportDialog.ModeJournalHint: Creates a journal in this world with one page per day.
ExportDialog.JournalNoPermission: You may not create journal entries.

Session.Label: Session {number}
Session.Speaker: Session
Session.EmptyEnded: The session had no messages, so it ended without saving.
Session.StartHint: Chat from now on belongs to this session and is archived in one go when you end it.

Auto.Name: Auto archive {date}
Auto.Done: Auto archive: {saved} saved, {deleted} cleared from the log

Select.ModeHint: Pick messages to bookmark, export or delete together (Shift+click selects a range)
Select.NothingDeletable: None of the selected messages can be deleted.
Select.DeleteConfirm: Delete {count} selected messages from the chat log? This cannot be undone.

Files.ImportTooltip: Import an archive JSON (also from another world) as a new archive
Files.ImportEmpty: There are no messages to import.
Files.MergeNeedTwo: Pick at least two archives to merge.
Files.MergeNameHint: Leave empty to join the original names
Files.MergeRemove: Remove the originals from the list afterwards
Files.ClearFile: Also empty the archive file on the server
Files.ClearFileHint: Foundry has no file deletion API, so the file is overwritten with a tiny tombstone to free the space. Delete the empty file from the server folder yourself if you want it gone.
Files.Cleared: The file of archive "{name}" was emptied and cannot be opened.

Images.NoPermission: You don't have file upload permission, so images can't be uploaded. (Settings → Configure Permissions → Upload Files)
Images.Waiting: Sending once the image upload finishes…
Images.ChatImagesActive: Gato's Chat Tools now handles chat images itself. Disable the Chat Images module to switch to it (while it is on, the compatibility patch is used).

Whisper.Title: Whisper target
Whisper.OneShot: Back to public after one message
Whisper.Hint: Recipients are worked out from ownership at the moment you send. GMs always receive whispers between players. Messages sent with commands such as /w or /r keep their usual behaviour.
Whisper.NoOwners: {names} has no player owner; sending to the GM only.
Whisper.NoUsers: No players chosen; sending to the GM only.
Whisper.TokenGone: The chosen token no longer exists; sending to the GM only.
Whisper.NoTargets: No targeted tokens; sending to the GM only.
Whisper.NoControlled: No selected tokens; sending to the GM only.
Whisper.NoSceneTokens: No tokens with an actor on the current scene.

TokenHud.Pinned: Chat now whispers to the owners of {name}.
